reasoning_content: The repo doesn't have node_modules installed locally. Let me take a different approach - the VPS has a working setup that was previously running (before my changes). The main issue is that package.json files were corrupted. Let me check what's on the VPS backup and try to restore it properly.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check the old backup
print("=== Old backup ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria_old/ 2>/dev/null | head -10")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Check if .git exists in old backup
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls /opt/areloria_old/.git 2>/dev/null && echo 'Has git' || echo 'No git'")
print("Git:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
PYEOF
